title: Staking Rewards Schedule
description: Extension schema for the vwp-digital-assets-staking-rewards extension. Constrains a core calculation object of type 'stakingRewardsSchedule': every reward with its units, the unit price at the date the pricing basis fixes (contract inception under ASC 606 noncash consideration, the recognition date, or the receipt date — declared in pricingDateBasis) and the fact that price comes from, the fair value recognized, and the chain-observed total the schedule must tie to. Located by type under calculations/; one schedule per asset and arrangement.

chainObservedUnits.description: Reward units RECEIVED on chain in the period (explorer, node or Bitwave sync); recognized units reconcile to this through the unreceived balances.

chainObservedFact.description: Fact id for the chain-observed total.

date.description: The recognition date (per the timing judgment); must lie within periodStart..periodEnd.

priceFact.description: Fact id whose value is {price, date}: the price on measurementDate from the pricing source.

reference.description: Transaction hash, epoch or validator reference identifying the reward; unique across schedules.

inceptionOn.description: Contract inception for this reward (the validation activity or committed period it relates to); required when pricingDateBasis is contractInception.

receivedOn.description: The on-chain receipt date; required when pricingDateBasis is receiptDate.

measurementDate.description: The date whose price measures the reward: inceptionOn, date or receivedOn per pricingDateBasis. The priceFact must state the price as of this date.

arrangement.description: Arrangement label (validator id, delegation, provider). Reward references must be unique and schedule periods must not overlap within one asset and arrangement.

pricingDateBasis.description: The date whose price measures each reward: contractInception (ASC 606-10-32-21 noncash consideration), recognitionDate (when control of the reward is obtained), or receiptDate (when the policy recognizes on receipt). The recognition-timing judgment decides this; later price movements are remeasurement, never income from staking.

unreceivedOpeningUnits.description: Units recognized in earlier periods but received in this one (opening balance of earned-not-received rewards).

unreceivedClosingUnits.description: Units recognized in this period but not yet received at periodEnd (closing balance of earned-not-received rewards).

unreceivedClosingFact.description: Fact id for the closing unreceived balance (checked against its value when present).

otherReconcilingUnits.description: Other reconciling units (fees netted at source, tips/MEV excluded from rewards), explained in reconciliationNote.
